class="absolute top-0 left-0 size-px"></span><p>Today we’re introducing The X Subscription, which brings together Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, and X Premium in one plan. Over the next few days, we’ll make it available to everyone globally.</p><p>For the first time, one AI subscription supports the full path from thinking and creating to building and sharing.</p><ul>
<li><strong>Grok</strong> supports chat, voice, and image and video generation.</li>
<li><strong>Grok Bot</strong> gives you AI teammates that get work done.</li>
<li><strong>Cursor</strong> provides leading local and cloud coding agents.</li>
<li><strong>X</strong> adds a checkmark, creator tools, and fewer ads, with higher tiers removing ads from the timeline entirely.</li>
</ul><p>Paid plans on The X Subscription include a generous pool of Grok model usage shared across Grok and Cursor. <strong>Each comparable new tier provides more usage-per-dollar than the plan it replaces.</strong></p><p>Your shared pool covers Grok models whether you use them in the Grok apps, the Grok tab on X, or Cursor. Each X Subscription plan includes at least twice as much coding usage with our models as the comparable Cursor plan. With the new plans, third-party models are still available in Cursor on Premium and above. Usage is billed separately at API list prices, through top-ups.</p><p>The X Subscription is available to new customers starting today.</p><p>We’re also rolling out the option to switch for existing SuperGrok, Cursor, and X Premium subscribers. You’ll see it in your account billing settings when it’s available to you. You can keep your current plan, or switch and get a prorated refund for your old plan.</p><h2 id="plans-and-pricing"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#plans-and-pricing">Plans and pricing</a></h2><p>The X Subscription gives you Grok, Cursor, and X for roughly what a comparable standalone plan for one of those products used to cost.</p><div class="sm:[&amp;_td:last-child]:whitespace-nowrap sm:[&amp;_th:last-child]:whitespace-nowrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Plan</th><th>Price</th><th>What’s Included</th><th>Included Usage</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Free</td><td>$0</td><td>Daily access to Grok, a starter allowance for Cursor&#x27;s coding agents, and standard X</td><td>Limited</td></tr><tr><td>Plus</td><td>$8/month</td><td>More AI usage in Grok and Cursor, plus a checkmark, creator tools, and fewer ads on X</td><td>Base</td></tr><tr><td>Premium</td><td>$30/month</td><td>The benefits of SuperGrok, Cursor Pro, and X Premium+, previously $90/month combined</td><td>4x Plus Plan</td></tr><tr><td>Super</td><td>$100/month</td><td>All of the above features</td><td>15x Plus Plan</td></tr><tr><td>Ultra</td><td>$200/month</td><td>All of the above features</td><td>50x Plus Plan</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="not-prose text-primary/60 my-6 text-sm leading-6">For further details on pricing, included usage and eligibility see <a href="/pricing" class="underline underline-offset-2 hover:text-primary">pricing page</a>.</p><h2 id="one-subscription-for-teams-and-enterprises"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#one-subscription-for-teams-and-enterprises">One subscription for Teams and Enterprises</a></h2><p>Team users get Premium, Super, and Ultra on The X Subscription at the same per-seat prices as individual plans. That&#x27;s priced lower per seat than older Cursor Teams but now includes 3x more coding usage, plus SSO, admin controls, consolidated billing, usage analytics, and SOC 2 compliance.</p><p>Enterprise customers can manage Grok and Cursor from one dashboard, with a single usage pool across both products. Our sales team is ready to help you <a href="/contact-sales">get started</a>.</p><h2 id="keep-your-current-plans-or-move-to-the-x-subscription"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#keep-your-current-plans-or-move-to-the-x-subscription">Keep your current plans or move to The X Subscription</a></h2><p>Nothing changes for existing SuperGrok, Cursor, or X Premium subscribers. You can keep your current plan, price, and features or move to The X Subscription.</p><p>Switching comes with limited-time offers, which you can see in your account billing settings.</p><h2 id="get-started"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#get-started">Get started</a></h2><p>Compare plans and sign up at <a href="/pricing">x.ai/pricing</a>.</p><p>If you already subscribe to SuperGrok,
